# AI Filmmakers Directory

> AI Filmmakers Directory (aifilmmakersdirectory.com) lists AI filmmakers and studios that producers, studios, agencies and brands can hire. Every profile below is a plain-HTML page. AIFD lists filmmakers; it does not recommend specific members.
